Pastry Chef

Northwind Bakery Wellington, New Zealand
1 week ago 12 applicants

Who We Are

Northwind Bakery is a family-run bakery with three shops across the city. We bake everything on site each morning and supply a handful of local cafes.

The Role

You will run the pastry section for our flagship shop, from laminated doughs to seasonal tarts.

What You Will Do

  • Partner with key stakeholders across the shops to plan the weekly pastry range
  • Prepare croissant, danish and brioche doughs to a consistent standard
  • Train and roster two junior bakers
  • Keep the section within food safety and waste targets

What You Bring

  • Three or more years in a pastry section
  • Early starts and weekend availability
  • A current food handler certificate
